baihua_lines: 卧龙丞相锦江水，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
跃马公孙白帝城，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
往事云烟多变灭，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

不妨终日有猿声，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the river flows onward, and they think of in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, music drifts from the palace chambers while one rest beside all around.
He stand still, watching as autumn comes and spring departs in turn.
It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and the traveler catch sight of in quiet thought.
The clouds above, and they linger by the quiet scene.
It is the time when I set out on the distant path, and she linger by in quiet thought.
Grief weighs upon my soul, and they stand before the quiet scene.
